skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Skills or technologies, e.g. Python, Java, React, AWS. A job matches if it lists any of them. Leave empty to list all jobs.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Optional cities, e.g. Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, Gurgaon, Mumbai, or Work From Home (or Remote). A job matches if it lists any of them. Leave empty for all of India.

years.title: Years of experience
years.description: Optional: only jobs open to candidates with this many years of experience. 0 = freshers.

jobFunctions.title: Job functions
jobFunctions.description: Optional Instahyre job functions (names as on instahyre.com), e.g. Backend Development, Full-Stack Development, Data Science / Machine Learning, DevOps / Cloud, Frontend Development, Mobile Development, Product Management. A job matches if it is in any of them.

companySize.title: Company size
companySize.description: Optional employer size filter, as Instahyre defines it.

maxItems.title: Max jobs
maxItems.description: Stop after this many jobs (in monitor mode: new, updated and removed jobs). Each job is billed as one event.

monitorMode.title: Monitor mode (new / updated / removed)
monitorMode.description: Flag each job with changeType new, updated or removed since the previous run with the same filters; unchanged jobs are skipped (not billed). Schedule the actor (e.g. daily) for change alerts: the first run is a baseline where every job is new. State is kept in the key-value store "instahyre-jobs-state" in your account.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy. Not needed normally: the Instahyre API answers datacenter IPs directly. If set, the actor switches to a new IP whenever a request is blocked or rate-limited.
